fields.headline: Hot, green and festive
fields.note: Hot and humid with tropical showers; cyclone season.
fields.highlight: New Year celebrations and Thaipoosam Cavadee.

fields.headline: Warm sea, lush island
fields.note: The hottest, wettest month; cyclones are possible.
fields.highlight: Chinese Spring Festival in Port Louis.

fields.headline: Summer winds down
fields.note: Still hot, with fewer showers towards the end.
fields.highlight: Maha Shivaratri pilgrimage to Grand Bassin; Independence Day (12 March).

fields.headline: Calm and sunny
fields.note: Warm days and cooler evenings; rain eases off.

fields.headline: Great for hiking
fields.note: Dry, sunny and pleasant - ideal for the trails.
fields.highlight: Labour Day (1 May); the hiking season begins.

fields.headline: Cool and breezy
fields.note: Winter starts: cooler, windier, especially in the south.

fields.headline: Winter on the island
fields.note: Coolest month; sunny on the north and west coasts.
fields.highlight: Humpback whales arrive off the west coast.

fields.headline: Whale watching
fields.note: Cool and dry, with steady trade winds.
fields.highlight: Whale and dolphin watching; European summer holidays.

fields.headline: Bright and dry
fields.note: One of the driest months; long sunny days.
fields.highlight: Diwali (festival of lights) - date varies, Oct/Nov.

fields.headline: Warm sea again
fields.note: Hot days and a warm sea; perfect for the beach.
fields.highlight: Diwali and Arrival of Indentured Labourers Day (2 November).

fields.headline: Summer holidays
fields.note: Hot and sunny with the first summer showers.
fields.highlight: Christmas, New Year festivities and flamboyant trees in bloom.
